route: route 3 (published scale totals / anchor direction) + route 7-8 (marker item)
evidence: Route 3 (published scale totals) + route 7/8 (marker item), on live irw_fetch data (178 complete respondents of 180) and on the study's own workbook. Route 3: the paper's Table 2 row 'Satisfaction with life' reads n 178, 5 items, M 4.57, SD 1.196, alpha 0.871; the live table's five items give n 178, mean of item means 4.571 (diff +0.001), SD of the person score 1.196 (diff 0.000), alpha 0.871 (diff -0.000). The rival reversed-anchor reading would give 3.429 against a published 4.57. Independently, in peerj-06-4903-s001.xlsx the study's own SLTOTAL equals SL1+..+SL5 as stored for 178/178 respondents and equals 40-(SL1+..+SL5) for only 8/178, so the table is stored raw and 1 = Strongly disagree .. 7 = Strongly agree is the correct anchor mapping. Route 7/8, corroborative: sl_5 is unique on the marker signature expected of 'If I could live my life over, I would change almost nothing' -- lowest mean 3.98 against 4.36/4.72/5.00/4.79, largest SD 1.81 against 1.27-1.55, and 10.7% at the floor against 1.1-2.2% for every other item; the two past-oriented items sl_4 and sl_5 carry the weakest corrected item-total correlations (0.641, 0.655) against 0.727-0.791 for sl_1..sl_3. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: no check here distinguishes one SWLS statement from another within {sl_1,sl_2,sl_3} or within {sl_4,sl_5}. Swapping sl_1 and sl_2 leaves the scale mean, SD, alpha and SLTOTAL bit-identical, and the marker pattern is consistent with, not proof of, the canonical printed order. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED. Re-runnable as verify_medvedev_2018_sl.R.

mapping_basis=data_labels: the IRW item code IS the stimulus letter string (data/megart_tonkovic_2021.R sets item = string from the deposit's own `string` column), so there is no code->text step to verify; item_text reproduces the code verbatim for all 5208 items. resp labels come from cda1012_doc_variable-metadata.tab (stimulus_acc, TRUE;FALSE) and the direction is confirmed by the live data: 3054 of 5208 items have resp identically 1 and 0 of 5208 have resp identically 0.
